summary: ArcelorMittal filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed offering of senior unsecured notes due in 2026. The filing describes a $ aggregate principal amount of % notes, with optional redemption prior to par call at make-whole price, and change-of-control put at 101%. Interest is semi-annual. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, and rank equally with existing unsecured debt. They will not be listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation mechanics apply.
